432:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Impressive. I can't win like this.」

432:t_024:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But you can't beat me.」

432:t_024:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You of all people should understand, $n?」

432:t_025:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Ha ha ha ha ha!」

432:t_026:0.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「I won't let you touch the Captain!」

432:t_028:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Impossible! Against $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ with his bare body...!」

432:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... That man is...」

432:t_028:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「We've known each other long enough. Let me give you the truth, at last.」

432:t_028:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「The times I didn't answer your questions... The times I ignored your requests... The reason is...」

432:t_028:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Because you belong to me.」

432:t_028:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I know everything about you. Your mother, your father and your sister, too...」

432:t_028:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「And the woman you had feelings for. ...Look, $n.」

432:t_028:13.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「Even you, $n, if you're going to try to kill Captain $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...!」

432:t_028:14.en:
$n
「$$マキ#pilot$$ is... $$クロノ$$'s... $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s...」

432:t_028:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「A good opportunity. I'll lift the shield I placed on your mind during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

432:t_028:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now you will sense me directly.」

432:t_029:2.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those eyes...! And now both of them!!」

432:t_029:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! Then you are... It can't be!!」

432:t_029:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's right. I am the being $n has been chasing... In his words...」

432:t_031:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... So you've shown your true nature as the last one.」

432:t_031:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let's go home, $$アサキム$$. There is still plenty we have to do.」

432:t_032:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Now you have seen my power.」

432:t_032:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I have my duty as the last one. Even the time I spend on you is too precious to waste.」

432:t_033:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「He's okay! I'm reading life signs!!」

432:t_034:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$...! What the hell is that guy!?」

432:t_034:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$クロノ$$ Reformists... So they've judged us to be their enemy...」

432:t_034:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't understand... Any of it...」

432:t_034:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return. We'll sort out the situation.」

432:t_034:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We cannot afford to stop moving. Now that we have liberated $$翠の地球$$, we head for $$蒼の地球$$.」

432:t_034:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「What awaits us there is $$サイデリアル$$... A battle with the $$新地球皇国$$, then.」

432:t_034:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「The Empire and its collaborators... And the $$クロノ$$ Reformists...」

432:t_034:9.en:
$$桂$$
「Which way is the world's tomorrow headed...?」

432:t_035:0.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「It's no good! There's no way to stop it!」

432:t_035:1.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You sure pull some lame stunts, $$サイデリアル$$!」

432:t_035:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Let's focus on hitting the enemy rather than stopping that thing!」

432:t_035:3.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I know! I'll pull it off, for $$セツコ$$'s sake too!」

432:t_036:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... If I don't start taking this seriously soon, I might get purged too...」

432:t_036:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I'm sorry, but I'll be excusing myself for today.」

432:t_037:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...If you know that, then I'll have you act accordingly, $$サルディアス・アクス$$...」

432:t_037:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「After all, you are my adjutant.」

432:t_038:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I see... So it's still not enough.」

432:t_038:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Why are you lending your strength to $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!?」

432:t_038:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Lend my strength? I have no such intention.」

432:t_038:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I always use this pitiful life for my own purpose, and nothing else.」

432:t_039:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That's fine, $$アサキム$$. Live however you like.」

432:t_039:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I shall allow it.」

432:t_040:1.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That white machine...! It's been a long time, um... um...」

432:t_040:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's $$クロウ・ブルースト$$.」

432:t_040:3.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「That's right, $$クロウ$$! It's been a while!」

432:t_040:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$クラヴィア$$... What are you doing here?」

432:t_040:5.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「Well... I tagged along with the Resistance to take part in the assault on this base, but...」

432:t_040:6.en:
$$クラヴィア$$
「I got separated along the way...」
